blocks.text: INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 08:48 AM November 25, 2026

After a tumultuous year for the Miss Universe Organization and its reigning queen Fatima Bosch of Mexico, the Miss Universe 2026 competition is coming to a close, with a dazzling coronation show to mark its Diamond edition on Wednesday, November 24 (25 in the Philippines) in Puerto Rico.

items: Bosch is set to relinquish her title to one of the 116 ladies from across the world, and bestow a new Miss Universe crown to the next queen.
The Philippines’ Bea Millan Windorski, who traces her maternal roots to La Union, is on a quest to bring home the country’s fifth crown.
